 Pennsylvania DoorDash driver missing after last delivery; abandoned vehicle found
 Sana Azem Updated 2026년 11월 9일 월 오후 12:06 UTC 0 ( NewsNation ) — Pennsylvania authorities are searching for a DoorDash driver who disappeared after making deliveries last month, according to the North Sewickley Township Police Department. 
 Zachariah Schuck, 32, was last seen the evening of Oct. 22 while working in the Monaca area, police said.
 Investigators said Schuck completed his last known DoorDash delivery at approximately 6:30 p.m. His cellphone signal was lost around 8 p.m., and he has not been heard from since.
 10-year-old found dead in car trunk; foster mother charged 
 Authorities later found Schuck's vehicle abandoned on Croxall Avenue, though police have not released details about any evidence recovered from the car.
 According to a missing-person flyer distributed by investigators, Schuck was last seen around 7:30 to 8 p.m. near Route 51 in Monaca, Pennsylvania.
 Advertisement
 Police describe Schuck as 6 feet tall and approximately 160 pounds, with brown hair and green eyes. He was last seen wearing a blue and red flannel shirt, blue jeans, and brown boots.
 Police urge the public to contact the North Sewickley Township Police Department if information about him is available. 
 10-year-old found dead in car trunk; foster mother charged 
 The circumstances surrounding Schuck's disappearance remain unclear. Investigators have not said whether foul play is suspected.
 Anyone with information about Schuck's whereabouts is urged to contact the North Sewickley Township Police Department at 724-843-3421 or 724-843-8118.
